news.title: IAT Remains Sole Admission Channel for 7 IISERs (BS-MS, BS & B.Tech) — Monitor Official Portal for 2026 Cycle
news.summary: All seven IISERs admit students to 5-Year BS-MS, 4-Year BS, and IISER Bhopal B.Tech. programmes exclusively through the IISER Aptitude Test (IAT). Aspirants should check iiseradmission.in for exact 2026–27 brochure release dates.

news.title: Ph.D. & Integrated Ph.D. Admission Cycles Across IISER Pune, Kolkata, Mohali, Bhopal & TVM
news.summary: IISERs conduct bi-annual Ph.D. admissions (August and January cohorts) accepting CSIR-UGC NET (JRF), GATE, JEST, NBHM, and DBT/ICMR fellowships. Verify department-specific deadlines directly on each campus site.

news.title: DST INSPIRE-SHE & National Scholarship Portal (NSP) Verification Advisory for Enrolled Students
news.summary: Eligible first-year BS-MS students must complete OTR on scholarships.gov.in or submit IISER endorsement forms on online-inspire.gov.in within official window deadlines.

news.title: NIRF Data & Career Outcomes: Balancing Doctoral Progression with Industry R&D and Analytics Roles
news.summary: Published NIRF 5-year UG data confirms that 55%–65%+ of IISER BS-MS graduates choose doctoral research globally, while median industry/placement packages for participating cohorts range around ₹7.0–₹9.0 LPA.

news.title: Rolling Faculty & Postdoctoral Recruitment Open Across IISER Pune, Kolkata & Berhampur
news.summary: Standing faculty advertisements for Assistant, Associate, and Professor positions along with institute postdoctoral fellowships are open across multiple departments.

news.title: IISER Kolkata CESSI & IISER Pune I-HUB Quantum Initiatives Expand National Science Infrastructure
news.summary: Inter-institutional research centres at IISERs continue major contributions to solar space weather (Aditya-L1 science), quantum hardware, climate modelling, and structural biology.

scholarships.name: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
scholarships.provider: Department of Science and Technology (DST), Govt. of India
scholarships.eligibility: Top 1% in Class 12 Board Examination OR top 10,000 rank in JEE/NEET/IAT (subject to DST active cut-off & natural sciences BS-MS/B.Sc. enrolment) aged 17–22 years. Verify exact IAT rank inclusion in current DST notification.
scholarships.benefitsAndAmount: ₹5,000 per month (₹60,000/yr) + ₹20,000 annual summer mentorship grant (Total ₹80,000/year).
scholarships.duration: Up to 5 years (or completion of BS-MS programme, subject to annual academic renewal CGPA ≥ 7.0).
scholarships.applicationProcedure: Apply online via online-inspire.gov.in after IISER admission confirmation and endorsement certificate from the Dean/Registrar.
scholarships.importantDates: Typically opens September – November each academic year.

scholarships.name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships (CSSS) & Top Class SC/ST Schemes
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Education / Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment / Tribal Affairs
scholarships.eligibility: Meritorious students from EWS/SC/ST/OBC/Minority backgrounds meeting family income ceilings (typically ₹4.5L–₹8L/yr depending on specific scheme).
scholarships.benefitsAndAmount: Covers full tuition/non-refundable fees up to scheme caps plus living/book allowances depending on specific NSP vertical.
scholarships.duration: Annual renewal based on academic progression.
scholarships.applicationProcedure: One-Time Registration (OTR) & application on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in), verified by IISER nodal officer.
scholarships.importantDates: Typically August – October (Verify NSP annual calendar).

scholarships.name: MoE Tuition Fee Waiver for SC / ST / PwD Students at IISERs

scholarships.eligibility: All regular BS-MS, BS, B.Tech, and Ph.D. students admitted under SC, ST, or PwD categories at any IISER.
scholarships.benefitsAndAmount: 100% Tuition Fee Exemption (saves ~₹88,000–₹98,000 per year; hostel/mess/medical fees remain payable unless covered by external aid).
scholarships.duration: Entire duration of the degree programme.
scholarships.applicationProcedure: Automatically applied during IISER admission fee payment upon verification of valid category/disability certificates.
scholarships.importantDates: At the time of admission & every semester registration.

courses.title: 5-Year BS-MS Dual Degree Programme
courses.eligibility: Class 12 (or equivalent) pass with Science stream and minimum 60% aggregate (55% for SC/ST/PwD). Admission exclusively through IAT.
courses.admissionProcedure: IISER Aptitude Test (IAT) score followed by centralized online counselling at iiseradmission.in.
courses.curriculumSummary: Years 1–2 cover compulsory interdisciplinary foundation courses across Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Maths, and Computing; Years 3–4 allow choosing a Major (and optional Minor); Year 5 is a full-year original MS research thesis.
courses.semesterStructure: Semesters 1–4: Core Interdisciplinary Sciences · Semesters 5–8: Major + Electives · Semesters 9–10: Full-Time Master’s Research Thesis.
courses.researchOpportunities: Mandatory 1-year Master’s thesis in frontier research laboratories, plus summer/winter research internships.
courses.internshipOpportunities: INSPIRE/IASc summer fellowships, international DAAD/MITACS internships, and R&D industry internships.
higherEducationOptions: Direct Ph.D. in India (TIFR, IISc, IITs, IISERs)
courses.salaryProspects: PhD fellowships start at ₹37,000/mo + HRA (India) or $30k–$45k/yr (abroad); Industry roles typically ₹6–14 LPA (estimated).

courses.title: 4-Year Bachelor of Science (BS) Programmes
courses.eligibility: Class 12 with Mathematics (mandatory for Economic Sciences & Economic/Statistical Sciences) and minimum 60% (55% SC/ST/PwD).
courses.admissionProcedure: Centralized IAT admission portal (iiseradmission.in) with programme-specific Mathematics requirement.
offeredAt: IISER Tirupati (Economic & Statistical Sciences — verify active cycle)
courses.curriculumSummary: Quantitative economics, statistical modelling, and computational finance paired with interdisciplinary science foundation courses.
courses.semesterStructure: Semesters 1–2: Core Foundations · Semesters 3–6: Core Economics/Statistics · Semesters 7–8: Electives & Capstone Research Project.
courses.researchOpportunities: Undergraduate thesis in econometrics, development economics, financial mathematics, or policy analytics.
courses.internshipOpportunities: RBI, NITI Aayog, economic think-tanks, quantitative finance, and data analytics firms.
courses.salaryProspects: Estimated entry industry range ₹7–15 LPA in analytics, consulting, and finance.

courses.title: 4-Year B.Tech. Programmes (IISER Bhopal)
courses.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM mandatory) and 60% aggregate (55% SC/ST/PwD).
courses.admissionProcedure: IAT score and centralized seat allocation through iiseradmission.in (verify active B.Tech counselling tab).
offeredAt: IISER Bhopal (Chemical Engineering, Data Science & Engineering, Electrical Engineering & Computer Science)
courses.curriculumSummary: Uniquely embeds engineering design and computing inside a pure-science research campus, combining strong theoretical math/science with industry-ready labs.
courses.semesterStructure: Semesters 1–2: Science & Engineering Core · Semesters 3–6: Branch Core & Labs · Semesters 7–8: Technical Electives & B.Tech Project.
courses.researchOpportunities: Undergraduate research in AI/ML, semiconductor devices, sustainable chemical processes, and robotics.
courses.internshipOpportunities: 6-month or summer internships in tech giants, chemical process industries, and semiconductor R&D.
higherEducationOptions: Direct Ph.D. in Engineering or Sciences
courses.salaryProspects: Estimated entry corporate range ₹8–18 LPA depending on role and company (verify CCD Bhopal reports).

courses.title: 2-Year Master of Science (M.Sc.) Programmes
courses.eligibility: Bachelor’s degree (B.Sc. / B.Tech. / equivalent) in relevant science discipline with minimum 60% or CGPA 6.0/10.
courses.admissionProcedure: IIT JAM score and/or institute-specific screening test & interview (check each IISER’s PG admission notice).
offeredAt: IISER Kolkata / Bhopal (Select tracks — verify active)
courses.curriculumSummary: Focused postgraduate coursework in the chosen discipline culminating in a 1-year or 1-semester Master’s dissertation.
courses.semesterStructure: Semesters 1–2: Core PG Theory & Labs · Semesters 3–4: Advanced Electives & M.Sc. Thesis.
courses.researchOpportunities: Direct access to advanced instrumentation and research groups on par with BS-MS Year 4–5.
courses.internshipOpportunities: Summer research projects between Year 1 and Year 2 at national/international labs.
courses.salaryProspects: Comparable to M.Sc. graduates from premier CFTIs (₹5–10 LPA estimated industry; ₹37k+HRA for PhD JRF).

courses.title: Integrated Ph.D. (Int-PhD) Programme

courses.admissionProcedure: Valid IIT JAM / JGEEBILS / NBHM / JEST score followed by rigorous institute interviews.
offeredAt: All 7 IISERs (Pune, Kolkata, Mohali, Bhopal, TVM, Tirupati, Berhampur)

courses.semesterStructure: Years 1–2: Coursework & Rotations (Fellowship ₹12k–₹16k/mo approx. MS phase) · Years 3+: Full Ph.D. JRF/SRF Fellowship.

courses.internshipOpportunities: Conference travel grants, international lab visits, and joint doctoral mentorship.
courses.salaryProspects: Funded fellowship during study (MS phase stipend + JRF ₹37,000/SRF ₹42,000 + HRA upon PhD registration; verify institute circular).

courses.title: Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) & Postdoctoral Fellowships
courses.eligibility: Master’s degree (M.Sc./M.Tech./BS-MS) with valid CSIR-UGC NET (JRF), GATE, JEST, DBT-JRF, ICMR-JRF, or INSPIRE Fellowship.
courses.admissionProcedure: Direct application to individual IISER admission portals twice a year (August & January cycles) + departmental interviews.
offeredAt: All 7 IISERs across Sciences, Engineering, Earth Sciences & Humanities

courses.semesterStructure: Year 1: Coursework & Proposal · Years 2–5+: Independent Research, Teaching Assistantship & Thesis Defense.
courses.researchOpportunities: Lead investigator-style research supported by DST, DBT, SERB/ANRF, and international funding grants.
courses.internshipOpportunities: Visiting scholar exchanges, industrial R&D collaborations, and international conferences.
courses.salaryProspects: Official DST/CSIR JRF ₹37,000/mo + HRA; SRF ₹42,000/mo + HRA; RA-I Postdoc ₹58,000/mo + HRA.

institutions.name: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Pune
institutions.campusAddress: Dr. Homi Bhabha Road, Pashan, Pune – 411008, Maharashtra, India
institutions.history: Established in 2006 by the Ministry of Education (then MHRD), Government of India, IISER Pune was among the first two IISERs founded alongside IISER Kolkata. It was declared an Institution of National Importance under the NITSER (Amendment) Act, 2012, and occupies a 98-acre green campus adjacent to NCL Pune.
institutions.vision: To create an internationally competitive centre of excellence where undergraduate teaching is seamlessly integrated with frontier scientific research.
institutions.mission: To nurture curious minds into world-class scientists, educators, and innovators across basic and interdisciplinary sciences through inquiry-led pedagogy.
departments: Department of Earth and Climate Science
Department of Humanities and Social Sciences
pgProgrammes: M.Sc. in Biotechnology / Life Sciences (verify active intake)
researchLabs: National Facility for Gene Function in Health and Disease
institutions.libraryFacilities: Smt. Indrani Balan Science Activity Centre & Central Library housing over 35,000+ books, e-journals (ScienceDirect, Springer, ACS, APS, Nature), and 24x7 reading rooms.
institutions.hostelFacilities: Fully residential campus with separate multi-storey hostels for UG, PG, and PhD scholars, high-speed LAN/Wi-Fi, common study rooms, and laundry amenities.
institutions.sportsAndExtracurriculars: Cricket & football grounds, indoor badminton/table tennis courts, gymnasium, Karavaan (annual cultural & science fest), Mimamsa (national science quiz), and 30+ student clubs.
institutions.studentLife: Vibrant interdisciplinary peer culture with strong student governance, annual science outreach to schools via Smt. Indrani Balan Science Activity Centre, and summer research mentorship.
institutions.scholarshipsAndAid: INSPIRE-SHE eligible students, SC/ST/PwD 100% tuition fee waiver per MoE rules, and institute PhD/Int-PhD fellowships.
institutions.admissionOverview: BS-MS admissions exclusively via IISER Aptitude Test (IAT). M.Sc. admissions via JAM; Integrated Ph.D. via JAM/JGEEBILS/NBHM + interview; Ph.D. via CSIR-NET/GATE/INSPIRE + interview.
institutions.placementCellOverview: Managed by the Career Development Cell (CDC), facilitating industry internships, R&D placements, consulting/analytics recruitment, and PhD application guidance.
institutions.alumniNetwork: Strong global alumni network pursuing doctorates and postdocs at Max Planck Institutes, MIT, ETH Zurich, Cambridge, IISc, TIFR, and leading biotech/analytics firms.
institutions.internshipOpportunities: Mandatory 5th-year MS thesis plus vibrant summer internship programmes (Summer Student Programme) funded via institute grants, IASc-INSA-NASI, and industry partners.
industryCollaborations: Atal Incubation Centre (AIC-IISER Pune) deep-tech startups
internationalCollaborations: University of Würzburg, Monash, & CNRS exchange ties
institutions.nirfRank2024: NIRF 2024 Overall: 29 · Research: 24 (verify latest NIRF cycle)

institutions.vision: To build a global research university rooted in basic sciences and interdisciplinary discovery for societal and technological advancement.
institutions.mission: To integrate rigorous classroom education with original laboratory and field research from the undergraduate level onwards.
departments: Centre of Excellence in Space Sciences India (CESSI)
Centre for Climate and Environmental Studies
pgProgrammes: M.Sc. in Space Physics / Sustainability / Chemical & Mathematical tracks (verify active intake)
researchLabs: Centre of Excellence in Space Sciences India (CESSI)
National Centre for High Hydrostatic Pressure Research
Central Instrumentation Facility (FESEM, TEM, XRD, NMR)
institutions.libraryFacilities: Central Library with extensive print collections, remote VPN access to major international journals, institutional DSpace repository, and air-conditioned reading zones.
institutions.hostelFacilities: Three major hostel complexes (Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose, Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar, and Nivedita Hall) with single/double rooms, Wi-Fi, and common lounges.
institutions.sportsAndExtracurriculars: Sports complex for athletics, football, basketball, lawn tennis, swimming/indoor sports, plus Inquivesta (India’s first annual science fest) and cultural societies.

institutions.name: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Bhopal
institutions.campusAddress: Bhopal Bypass Road, Bhauri, Bhopal – 462066, Madhya Pradesh, India
institutions.history: Established in 2008, IISER Bhopal occupies a sprawling 200-acre campus in Bhauri. It is uniquely distinguished among IISERs for introducing 4-year BS Engineering Sciences, Economic Sciences, and 4-year B.Tech programmes alongside the 5-year BS-MS.
institutions.vision: To build an academic institution bridging fundamental natural sciences, engineering sciences, and economic sciences for national development.
institutions.mission: To deliver world-class education and translational research while fostering entrepreneurship and interdisciplinary problem-solving.
departments: Department of Earth and Environmental Sciences
Department of Data Science and Engineering
Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science
Department of Humanities and Social Sciences
ugProgrammes: 4-Year B.Tech. (Chemical Engineering, Data Science & Engineering, Electrical Engineering & Computer Science)
phdProgrammes: Ph.D. across Natural Sciences, Engineering Sciences & Economics
researchAreas: Data Science, Machine Learning & Computer Vision
researchLabs: Centre for Research on Environment and Sustainable Technologies (CREST)
Central Instrumentation Facility (FESEM, TEM, XPS, 500/700 MHz NMR)
Innovation and Incubation Centre for Entrepreneurship (IICE)
scientificInfrastructure: Chemical Engineering Pilot & Process Control Labs
institutions.libraryFacilities: Central Library equipped with digital research databases, RFID automation, spacious reading wings, and collaborative study pods.
institutions.hostelFacilities: Eight modern hostels on the Bhauri campus housing UG, PG, and PhD students with high-speed internet, sports courts, and common rooms.
institutions.sportsAndExtracurriculars: Large multi-sport stadium, synthetic courts, swimming/gym facilities, Enthuzia (annual cultural fest), Singularity (science fest), and active coding/robotics clubs.
institutions.studentLife: Blends pure-science inquiry with engineering and economics cohorts, yielding strong tech/coding clubs, entrepreneurship hackathons, and vibrant campus fests.
institutions.scholarshipsAndAid: INSPIRE-SHE (for Natural Science BS-MS), MoE SC/ST/PwD tuition waivers, and merit-cum-means assistance.
institutions.admissionOverview: Admissions to BS-MS, B.Tech, and BS Economic Sciences are conducted through IAT (verify specific Maths/stream eligibility for B.Tech/Economics in the official IAT brochure).
institutions.placementCellOverview: Centre for Career Development (CCD) actively manages campus placements for B.Tech, BS, and BS-MS cohorts across tech, consulting, analytics, core engineering, and R&D.
institutions.alumniNetwork: Graduates placed in global PhD programs as well as software, quantitative finance, chemical engineering, and data science organizations.
institutions.internshipOpportunities: Structured industry & research internship pathways supported by CCD and IICE startups.
industryCollaborations: AI, telecom, and chemical process industry research grants
internationalCollaborations: MoUs with European, North American, and Japanese universities
Joint Indo-German and Indo-Australian research projects

feeSummary.sourceNote: Official IISER Bhopal Academic Fee Portal (iiserb.ac.in)

institutions.name: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Thiruvananthapuram
institutions.campusAddress: Maruthamala PO, Vithura, Thiruvananthapuram – 695551, Kerala, India
institutions.history: Established in 2008, IISER Thiruvananthapuram sits on a scenic 200-acre campus in Vithura nestled at the foothills of the Agasthyamalai hills in the Western Ghats.
institutions.vision: To attain global recognition as a premier institution integrating high-quality science education with cutting-edge fundamental and translational research.
institutions.mission: To foster scientific temper, ecological awareness, and interdisciplinary excellence across physical, chemical, biological, mathematical, and data sciences.
departments: School of Data Science (and Interdisciplinary i²Sc)
School of Earth, Environmental and Sustainability Sciences
ugProgrammes: 5-Year BS-MS in Integrated & Interdisciplinary Sciences (i²Sc — Biological, Chemical, Physical, Mathematical, Data Sciences)
pgProgrammes: 2-Year M.Sc. in Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics
researchLabs: Central Instrumentation Facility (500 MHz NMR, HR-TEM, XPS, SQUID)
institutions.libraryFacilities: Central Library offering extensive print and electronic journal subscriptions, digital repositories, and serene hillside reading rooms.
institutions.hostelFacilities: Dedicated student hostels set amidst the lush Vithura campus with dining halls, high-speed internet, and student recreation lounges.
institutions.sportsAndExtracurriculars: Indoor stadium, outdoor sports grounds, trekking/nature clubs exploring the Western Ghats, Ishya (annual cultural fest), and Anvesha (science fest).
institutions.studentLife: Close-knit residential community known for exceptional ecological research exposure, strong physics/chemistry cohorts, and serene natural surroundings.
institutions.scholarshipsAndAid: INSPIRE-SHE, MoE SC/ST/PwD tuition waivers, and state/central scholarship portals.
institutions.admissionOverview: BS-MS and i²Sc BS-MS admissions via IAT; 2-year M.Sc. via IAT/JAM (verify latest M.Sc. brochure); Ph.D. via national fellowships and interviews.
institutions.placementCellOverview: Placement & Career Counselling Cell assists graduating BS-MS and M.Sc. cohorts with R&D jobs, analytics roles, and doctoral applications.
institutions.alumniNetwork: Strong PhD progression to European, US, and Indian institutions plus roles in pharma, data science, and R&D.
institutions.internshipOpportunities: Active summer visiting student programmes and proximity to VSSC (ISRO), RGCB, and NIIST in Thiruvananthapuram.
industryCollaborations: Regional research ecosystem with VSSC-ISRO, CSIR-NIIST, and RGCB
institutions.nirfRank2024: NIRF 2024 Overall: 101–150 band (verify latest NIRF cycle)

institutions.name: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Tirupati
institutions.campusAddress: Srinivasapuram-Jangalapalli Village, Panguru (G.P), Yerpedu Mandal, Tirupati – 517619, Andhra Pradesh, India
institutions.history: Established in 2015 by the Ministry of Education (initially mentored by IISER Pune), IISER Tirupati has transitioned to its permanent 244-acre campus in Yerpedu near the Tirumala foothills and IIT Tirupati.
institutions.vision: To build a premier science university fostering curiosity, interdisciplinary problem-solving, and regional-to-global scientific innovation.
institutions.mission: To integrate foundational coursework with early hands-on research training and industry/academic collaboration.
ugProgrammes: 4-Year BS in Economic and Statistical Sciences (verify active IAT cycle)
pgProgrammes: Professional Master’s / M.Sc. programmes (verify active intake)
researchLabs: Central Instrumentation Facility (NMR, XRD, Electron Microscopy)
scientificInfrastructure: 400 MHz NMR & Single Crystal X-Ray Diffractometer
institutions.libraryFacilities: Modern Central Library on the Yerpedu permanent campus with print textbooks, digital journal portals, and quiet study zones.
institutions.hostelFacilities: Newly constructed permanent residential hostels with modern amenities, Wi-Fi connectivity, dining facilities, and recreational areas.
institutions.sportsAndExtracurriculars: Sports fields, indoor badminton/table tennis, cultural & science clubs, and participation in Inter-IISER Sports & Cultural Meets.
campusFacilities: Proximity to IIT Tirupati Research Ecosystem
institutions.studentLife: Rapidly expanding permanent campus community with close faculty-student mentorship, active coding/journal clubs, and growing research infrastructure.
institutions.scholarshipsAndAid: INSPIRE-SHE, MoE SC/ST/PwD tuition waivers, and central/state scholarships via NSP.
institutions.admissionOverview: BS-MS admissions conducted through IAT. Integrated Ph.D. and Ph.D. admissions via national examinations (JAM/NET/GATE/JEST) and institute interviews.
institutions.placementCellOverview: Placement & Career Development Cell coordinates internships, skill-building workshops, and corporate/research recruitment.
institutions.alumniNetwork: Early cohorts have secured doctoral fellowships in Europe, US, Japan, and premier Indian institutes alongside industry roles.
institutions.internshipOpportunities: Annual Summer Research Programme and collaborative internships with IIT Tirupati and Sri City industrial corridor.
industryCollaborations: Pharmaceutical and biotech R&D partnerships in AP/Telangana belt
internationalCollaborations: Active faculty research grants with international universities
institutions.nirfRank2024: Verify latest NIRF submission on official portal

institutions.name: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Berhampur
institutions.campusAddress: At/Po: Laudigaon, Konisi, Police Station: Golanthara, Dist. Ganjam, Berhampur – 760003, Odisha, India
institutions.history: Founded in 2016 (initially mentored by IISER Bhopal), IISER Berhampur is the newest of the seven IISERs and operates from its modern permanent 200-acre coastal campus at Laudigaon near Gopalpur-on-Sea, Odisha.
institutions.vision: To emerge as a globally respected centre of scientific education and coastal/fundamental research in eastern India.
institutions.mission: To empower undergraduate and doctoral students with rigorous scientific foundations and modern experimental/computational training.
pgProgrammes: Check official academic portal for M.Sc. updates
phdProgrammes: Ph.D. in Biological, Chemical, Physical & Mathematical Sciences
researchAreas: Marine & Coastal Ecology (Bay of Bengal proximity)
Condensed Matter, Quantum Materials & High-Energy Physics
researchLabs: Central Sophisticated Instrumentation Centre (NMR, XRD, SEM)
scientificInfrastructure: Modern Undergraduate Teaching & Research Labs on Laudigaon Campus
institutions.libraryFacilities: Central Library on the permanent Laudigaon campus providing digital journal access, core reference books, and extended reading hours.
institutions.hostelFacilities: Newly built permanent hostels at Laudigaon offering single/shared rooms, campus Wi-Fi, dining halls, and indoor recreation.
institutions.sportsAndExtracurriculars: Outdoor sports grounds, indoor fitness facilities, Kshitij/Inquivesta-style student festivals, and active science, coding, and photography clubs.
campusFacilities: Bus shuttle to Berhampur city & Gopalpur coast
institutions.studentLife: Close-knit, high-energy campus near the Bay of Bengal coast with strong faculty accessibility and rapid growth in research infrastructure.
institutions.scholarshipsAndAid: INSPIRE-SHE, MoE SC/ST/PwD tuition waivers, and Odisha state/central NSP scholarships.
institutions.admissionOverview: BS-MS admission through IAT (iiseradmission.in). Ph.D. and Integrated Ph.D. admissions through national fellowships (NET/GATE/JEST/JAM) and interviews.
institutions.placementCellOverview: Career Development & Placement Cell guides graduating cohorts into PhD programs, R&D fellowships, and analytics/education careers.
institutions.alumniNetwork: Graduating batches have entered doctoral programmes in India and abroad (IISc, TIFR, Europe, US) and early-career technical roles.
institutions.internshipOpportunities: Summer Internship Programme and research collaborations with NISER Bhubaneswar, IIT Bhubaneswar, and national labs.
industryCollaborations: Coastal, environmental, and materials science R&D partnerships
internationalCollaborations: International faculty research collaborations in Europe, US, and East Asia
institutions.nirfRank2024: Verify latest NIRF submission on official portal
